title: Design Studio mechatronic project (format design-studio.project/3)
description: One document spanning mechanical solids and the electronic board, with cross-domain constraints and a design-rationale trail that records bidirectional design<->engineering co-evolution (a design intent records the mechanical AND electronic changes it drove, and engineering constraints can drive design changes the other way).

units.description: mechanical + electronic share int64 nanometre coordinates

materials.description: ONE library, multi-domain properties (mechanical + thermal + electronic).

electronic.description: for substrate/laminate materials shared with the board

parts.description: mechanical solids; geometry referenced out-of-line (B-rep file).

board.description: the electronic board, unchanged design-studio.project/2 object (referenced or embedded).

tree.description: nested assembly nodes referencing parts[].id / sub-assemblies

constraints.description: CROSS-DOMAIN constraints: this is where design and engineering meet. A 'fit' couples a mechanical mate to an electrical connector's pin map; 'thermal'/'emi' couple board power to enclosure geometry. Editing one side is expected to drive the other (co-evolution).

domains.description: the domains this constraint couples (>=1; cross-domain when 2).

refs.description: parts[].id / board net or pad ids

rationale.description: the design-rationale trail (Lawson/Cross co-evolution). Each entry records an intent, the alternatives weighed, the gate that approved it, the source (human or a specific AI model), AND the changes it drove in BOTH domains — capturing bidirectional design<->engineering influence and serving as the AI audit log + the seed for an auto-drafted design narrative.

drove.description: the changes this intent propagated, per domain (bidirectional).

driven_by.description: if this change was forced by an engineering constraint feeding back into design, name it (the reverse direction).
